if n then if n > 1733 then n = 1733; Options.MoneyQty:SetValue('1733') end; getgenv().MoneyInput = n else getgenv().MoneyInput = 0 end end}); Value:AddToggle('AutoFarm', {Title = 'Auto Farm Loop', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoFarm = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'); while getgenv().AutoFarm do local qty = getgenv().MoneyInput or 0; if qty > 0 then local targetDist = qty * 3; local char = lp.Character; local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if hrp then hrp.Anchored = true; local currentDist = lp:GetAttribute('CurrentDistance') or 0; local checkDist = math.round(tonumber(currentDist) or 0); if checkDist ~= targetDist then local calcX = -7171 + targetDist; hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(calcX, 50, -136); local startWait = tick(); repeat task.wait(0.1) until math.round(tonumber(lp:GetAttribute('CurrentDistance')) or 0) == targetDist or tick() - startWait > 3 or not getgenv().AutoFarm end; checkDist = math.round(tonumber(lp:GetAttribute('CurrentDistance')) or 0); if checkDist == targetDist then local ragdoll = rs:FindFirstChild('Ragdoll'); if ragdoll then ragdoll:FireServer(); Fluent:Notify({Title = 'Success', Content = 'Selling Raft...', Duration = 1}); repeat task.wait(0.1) until math.round(tonumber(lp:GetAttribute('CurrentDistance')) or 0) ~= targetDist or not getgenv().AutoFarm end end; if hrp.Parent then hrp.Anchored = false end end end; task.wait(0.1) end end) else local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character; local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local char = lp.Character; local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if V then if hrp then getgenv().OriginalPlayerCFrame = hrp.CFrame end; task.spawn(function() while getgenv().AutoWins do local character = lp.Character; local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); local hb = workspace:FindFirstChild('Endzone') and workspace.Endzone:FindFirstChild('EndzoneHitbox'); if root and hb then root.CFrame = hb.CFrame end; task.wait(0.1) end end) else if hrp and getgenv().OriginalPlayerCFrame then hrp.CFrame = getgenv().OriginalPlayerCFrame; getgenv().OriginalPlayerCFrame = nil end end end})

local creatures = {}; for _, v in ipairs(game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Creatures:GetChildren()) do table.insert(creatures, v.Name) end; getgenv().SelectedCreature = creatures[1] or ''; Value:AddDropdown('CreatureSelect', {Title = 'Select Creature', Values = creatures, Default = getgenv().SelectedCreature, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SelectedCreature = V end}); Value:AddToggle('AutoCreature', {Title = 'Auto Grant Reward', Description = 'Continuously grants selected creature', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoCreature = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local remote = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('GrantReward'); while getgenv().AutoCreature do if getgenv().SelectedCreature ~= '' and remote then remote:InvokeServer({['type'] = 'SeaCreature', ['displayName'] = getgenv().SelectedCreature}) end; task.wait(.015) end end) end end})
